app.name: Departure board
app.summary: A board of the next departures of one or more lines from a Home Assistant sensor, mixed and counting down.
app.header_hint: A title line above the rows when there is room. Every row still shows its own line and destination.
app.late_hint: A departure that runs a minute or more late gets "+2" behind where it goes.
app.max_rows_hint: 0 fills the tile with as many rows as fit. Set a number to show fewer on a large tile.
app.time_format_hint: How the departure time reads: minutes only (countdown, "now" under a minute), the time of day (24h), or both ("5 min · 14:20").
